afk:
• `!afk [reason]`
Sets your profile away. Alerts users when you are tagged.
purge:
• `!purge [1-99]` (or `!c` / `!p`)
Bulk deletes a specified number of recent text chat lines instantly.
pus:
• `!pus @member [1-99]`
Target purges text entries *only* from that specific user profile.
snipe:
• `!snipe [index]` (or `!s`)
Recovers recently deleted messages from local channel memory logs.
cs:
• `!cs`
Flushes the local channel message sniper memory log bank clean.
slowmode:
• `!slowmode [duration/off]`
Sets precision rate-limiting cooldown limits on text chat streams.
nick:
• `!nick @member [name]` (or `!n`)
Forces a server profile identity nickname override update instantly.
cn:
• `!cn @member`
Strips all profile nickname overrides back down to default server data.
warn:
• `!warn @member [reason]`
Issues a custom disciplinary strike card directly to a user's private DMs.
warns:
• `!warnings @member`
Audits a user's chronological strike archive files sheet row-by-row.
clearwarns:
• `!clearwarns @member`
Wipes a member's strike registry card cleanly back to zero active strikes.
mute:
• `!mute @member [duration] [reason]`
Restricts voice and chat capabilities for a temporary locked duration window.
unmute:
• `!unmute @member`
Restores normal server profile voice and chat accessibility configurations.
kick:
• `!kick @member [reason]`
Safely removes a target account profile out of the server grid system.
ban:
• `!ban @member [reason]`
Bans and restricts a target user account profile permanently.
r:
• `!r add/remove @member [role search keyword]`
Modifies role assignments using high-speed fuzzy search keyword matching.
say:
• `!say [#channel] [text]`
Broadcasts an anonymous message directly through the bot.
ticketsetup:
• `!ticketsetup [type] [color_hex] [Title] | [Description]`
Spawns a specific Tickety panel room button mapping setup in text channels.
close:
• `!close`
Locks, archives, and deletes an active text help desk ticket support channel.
prefix:
• `!prefix [new_symbol]`
Updates your custom system command trigger prefix configuration matrix.
